$comment: Which test files can differ by system (DR-0754, DR-0758). On every PR Windows and macOS run the files under system and every test marked smoke (`gate os`); the nightly runs every file there (`gate os --all`), and Linux runs every file on every PR. Every test file is named once: under system with its kind and why it can differ, or under same. The gate's systems step fails a test file named nowhere and a name that isn't a test file; and a file under same that names the system, skips by it, or makes links, file modes or file times, unless signals says why it runs the same everywhere.
